design: bipartite matching (Kuhn augmenting paths) between target positions and blocks

title: Bring Servers Down
design: server i needs t_i = ceil(health[i] / k) consecutive hits and costs request[i] per round until it falls; ordering servers by t_i / request[i] ascending (exchange argument, compared by integer cross-multiplication) minimises sum request[i] * finish round

title: Bubble Explosion

title: Build Binary Tree From Character Counts

design: count characters, then a binary min-heap keyed by (count, creation id); merge two at a time

design: count words in a hash map, pair each word with its reverse, pair palindromic words with themselves and keep one leftover palindromic word for the middle

title: Build Smallest Number  (Variant 1)
design: count the digits (counting sort), write the smallest non-zero digit, then every remaining digit in increasing order

title: Build Smallest Number  (Variant 2)
complexity: O(n log n * d + distinct * total digits) time/O(total digits) space
design: sort the strings with the comparator a + b < b + a; for each distinct non-zero value x, form x followed by the sorted rest with one x removed, and keep the smallest such string

title: Build the Longest Spike
design: count values in a hash map; the maximum is the peak, every other value contributes min(count, 2)

title: Build Transition Graph
design: hash map user->entries, sort each user by integer timestamp, hash map of edge counts, final sort

title: Bulk Fruit Order Discount

title: Business CSV Data Validator

title: Cake Order Fulfillment Check
design: single pass with three running counters

title: Calculate Board Score

title: Calculate Dasher Salary

title: Calculate Equation Expression (Variant 2)

title: Calculate Equation Expression (Variant 3)
design: iterative three-colour DFS from the target; a grey hit or missing name marks failure and propagates

title: Calculate Process Starvation

design: completion of task i = sum_j min(a_j, a_i - 1) + #{j <= i : a_j >= a_i}; sorted prefix sums plus a Fenwick tree over value ranks

title: Call Elevator

title: Camera Motion Detection (Variant 1)

title: Camera Motion Detection (Variant 2)

title: Car Fleet Scheduler (Variant 2)

title: Cellular Infection Spreading (Variant 2)
design: multi-source breadth-first search by days: keep for every healthy plant the number of infected neighbours; when a plant is infected on day d, add one to each healthy neighbour and put a neighbour that reaches threshold into the day d + 1 frontier; the answer is the last infection day if every plant was reached, else -1

title: Cellular Infection Spreading (Variant 3)

design: multi-source breadth-first search by days: keep for every healthy plant the number of infected neighbours; when a plant is infected on day d, add one to each healthy neighbour and put a neighbour that reaches threshold into the day d + 1 frontier; a plant is infected after days days exactly when its infection day is at most days

title: Cellular Infection Spreading (Variant 5)
design: multi-source breadth-first search by days: keep for every healthy plant the number of infected neighbours; when a plant is infected on day d, add one to each healthy neighbour and put a neighbour that reaches threshold into the day d + 1 frontier; write each plant's day when it is infected

title: Chat Message Events Aggregation (Variant 3)

title: Check Prefix Permutation
design: record the position of every value; sweep k upward keeping the minimum and maximum position of 1..k; k holds when max - min + 1 == k

title: Chunk a List of Lists
complexity: O(total values + number of inner lists) time/O(total values) space
design: stream the values with one current buffer that is emitted whenever it reaches size

title: Circular Prime Number Check
design: rotate with arithmetic; 6k+-1 trial division up to sqrt per rotation

complexity: O(T + k) per store, O(k) per free
design: boolean slot array; single scan with a running free-run length over offsets 0..T+k-2; free-count shortcut

title: Closest Pair of Points
design: divide and conquer on x-sorted points with a y-merge and a strip check of the next 7 neighbours, all in exact integer squared distances

design: scaled integer (1e-4 dollars) arithmetic; BigInt in JavaScript

title: Cloud Service Usage Cost (Variant 2)
design: aggregate hours per service, charge each tier slice min(limit,h)-prev

title: Cloud Service Usage Cost (Variant 3)
complexity: O(rows + s log s) time/O(s) space
design: scaled-integer tier slices, sort by (-exact cost, name)

title: Cloud Storage System (Variant 1)
design: hash map name -> size

title: Cloud Storage System (Variant 2)

design: hash map plus sorted name index (insertion-sorted, lazily rebuilt after restore); findFile scans only the prefix range, filters by endswith, sort by (-size,name)

title: Cloud Storage System (Variant 3)
complexity: O(log F + R + h log h) per find (R names in prefix range, h hits), O(F) per insert/restore
design: files map name->(size,owner), per-user capacity, used total and owned-name set

complexity: O(log F + R + h log h) per find, O(owned files) per backup/restore
design: level-3 structures plus per-user snapshot arrays

design: DP over (house, energy capped at n) with max coins; -1 marks unreachable

title: Collatz Sequence Steps
design: direct loop with exact integer halving; values stay below 2**53 for n <= 1e7

title: Color a Row of Houses
design: closed form ((k-1)^(n-1) + (k-1)(-1)^(n-1))/k (same colours) or ((k-1)^(n-1) - (-1)^(n-1))/k, with modular inverse; BigInt in JavaScript

title: Company Role Assignment
complexity: O(e + n) expected time/O(e + n) space
design: a set of (company, contact, role) keys and a set of (company, role) keys, both updated when an association is accepted

title: Compress N-ary Tree
design: walk the preorder rows once with a stack of (node, remaining children, nearest kept ancestor); every kept node is appended to its nearest kept ancestor's child list, and kept nodes keep their original preorder

title: Compute Server Load Scores
design: hash map server->times; sort times; burst if previous time within 60 s or next time equal

title: Concurrent Web Crawler
design: BFS with visited set (thread pool scheduling modelled away)

title: Connect Points in 2D Matrix
complexity: O(alpha) per addPoint and isConnected; O(points in the component) per getMinSteps
design: union-find over row and column lines (a point unites its row and its column) answers isConnected; getMinSteps checks the union-find first, then runs a BFS over lines where each row or column is expanded once

title: Construct Restaurant Daily Menu
design: iterative explicit-stack copy that skips inactive subtrees

title: Convert Snake Case to Camel Case
design: hand-written scanner over identifier runs with char-code tests

title: Copy Neighbor Sums Between Binary Trees
design: decode each tree into child arrays, then a breadth-first walk over (source node, target node) pairs that creates missing target nodes, then level-order serialisation

title: Correct Bedroom Counts from Descriptions
design: manual tokenisation into alphanumeric words, then word and bigram checks

title: Count Alert Triggers
design: one sliding count of bad hours updated by the entering and leaving hour, compared with integer arithmetic

title: Count and Flip Binary Operations
design: prefix counts once plus a flip parity bit

title: Count Days for Scheduled Tasks
complexity: O(u log(goal * max interval)) time for u distinct intervals/O(u) space
design: binary search on d over the monotone count sum(floor((d - 1) / interval) + 1), grouping equal intervals and stopping a sum early once it reaches goal

title: Count Distinct Elements in Window
design: a hash map from value to count in the current window and a running distinct counter updated by the entering and leaving value

title: Count Distinct Passwords
design: Count unequal endpoint pairs, plus the unchanged string. Strip equal ends from a reversal to identify its unique first/last changed positions.

title: Count Dropped Requests
design: because times are sorted, compare requestTime[i] with requestTime[i-3], requestTime[i-20] and requestTime[i-60]

title: Count Fully Covered User Clusters
design: Flood each user component once; keep a covered flag while visiting all cells, even after finding an uncovered cell.

title: Count Grid Squares
complexity: O(queries) arithmetic operations; integer bit cost applies
design: Expand the sum of (r-k+1)(c-k+1) and use exact integer sums of k and k squared.

title: Count Incorrect Sale Prices
design: a hash map from product name to correct price, then one pass over the sales

title: Count Intervals Covering Point
complexity: O(n log n) build, O(log n) per query/O(n) space
design: sorted starts and sorted ends; count = #(starts <= x) - #(ends < x) by two binary searches

title: Count Islands and Water Boundary
design: iterative BFS flood fill counting water sides

title: Count Maximum Borrowing Days
design: subset dynamic programming: reach[mask] is the bitmask of lenders that can end a plan using exactly mask; extend by every unused lender whose lend covers the payback of some possible last lender

title: Count Objects in Pin
complexity: O(R * C) time and black-box calls/O(R * C) space
design: one BFS per unvisited object pixel, calling isSameObject only on 4-neighbours

title: Count of Stable Subarrays
design: with prefix sums P, segment l..r is stable when capacity[l] == capacity[r] and P[r] - P[l + 1] == capacity[r]; scan r from left to right, make left end l = r - 2 available by counting the key (capacity[l], P[l + 1]) in a hash map, and add the count of key (capacity[r], P[r] - capacity[r])

title: Count Reversing Triples
design: compress values to ranks; for each middle index multiply the number of larger values to its left by the number of smaller values to its right, both counted with Fenwick trees

title: Count Singler Role Co-occurrences
complexity: O(sum over singers of R_s * P_s + p log p) time/O(p) space
design: per singer, sorted distinct years per role; for each pair of roles a two-pointer merge finds whether the closest years are within period

title: Count Valid Binary Combinations
complexity: O(L * m) time with run checks by prefix counts/O(L * m) space
design: dynamic programming over (position, segments placed): place the next run at the current position when it fits and is followed by a non-"1", or skip a non-"1" character

title: Counting Words in a Text
complexity: O(n + W log W) time/O(W) space
design: one hash-map count, sort the distinct frequencies, keep words whose frequency is at least the k-th largest, sort by (-frequency, word)

title: CPU Usage Analysis
complexity: O(n + t log t) time/O(n) space
design: stack of open task names; on each event add (timestamp - previous timestamp) to the task on top, then push or pop

design: Bellman-Ford max-product relaxation on scaled big integers

design: reverse adjacency; BFS from the camera over owners, member groups and member users

complexity: O(N log N + log(range) * k * log m) time/O(N) space
design: local sort per worker; value-range binary search for the k-th smallest with per-worker bisect counts

design: merge blocks per person, sweep +1/-1 events of the merged intervals in day order, and emit the clipped segments where people - busy >= k

title: Find Destination Node (Variant 1)

title: Find Destination Node (Variant 2)
complexity: O(E + V log V) time/O(E) space

design: sort ranges by start; sweep gaps between consecutive ranges and to 999

design: iterative traversal; manual character scan of digit/dot runs; split and octet checks; set then sort

title: Find Lowest Common Manager

title: Find Maximum Trade Shares

design: topological order; for each course a bitset of possible distances from a start (forward) and to an end (backward); a course is a middle when some up-distance a and down-distance b satisfy b == a or b == a + 1

title: Find Missing Subsequence Words

title: Find Optimal Commute (Variant 2)
design: Dijkstra on lexicographic (time, cost) with node-departure weights

title: Find Optimal Moves
design: one pass summing every positive rise arr[i] - arr[i-1] (with arr[-1] = 0)

title: Find Path in Fibonacci Tree
design: subtree sizes S(n) = F(n + 2) - 1 let each label descend from the root in O(n) without building the tree; drop the common prefix of the two root paths and emit U per remaining start step

title: Find Path in N-ary Tree (Variant 1)
design: level-by-level frontier: keep the set of nodes matching the path prefix and expand to children equal to the next path value

title: Find Path in N-ary Tree (Variant 2)
complexity: O(nodes + memoized transitions) time/O(nodes + path) space
design: depth-first traversal carrying a KMP automaton state for the root-to-node value string; transitions are memoized per (state, value) so failure links are followed at most once per pair

title: Find Path with Minimal Bottleneck
complexity: O((n + m) log m) time/O(n + m) space
design: binary search over the sorted distinct weights; each probe runs a breadth-first search from node 1 over edges not heavier than the probe and checks that node n is within k hops

title: Find Pattern Matching Words
design: per word, a rolling boolean dynamic programme over pattern positions: a "." cell is true when the previous character row was true at the same or the previous pattern position

title: Find Peak Event Moment
design: sort entry times and exit times separately and sweep in time order, processing exits before entries at equal times, recording the first time the count exceeds the best

title: Find Redeemable Offers
complexity: O(E + U log U + U * O) time/O(E) space
design: one pass over events with a hash map keyed by (user, offer); then one row per sorted user over the active offers

title: Find Redundant Substring
design: length = V + C, so the rule is (1 - a) V + (1 - b) C = 0; count equal prefix keys (1 - a) Vp + (1 - b) Cp with a hash map

title: Find Restaurant Intervals
design: sweep: turn reservations into +seats/-seats events, sort them, walk times keeping the reserved total, and open/close output intervals when free seats cross partySize

title: Find Robots Position
design: four directional sweeps keeping the last blocker index

title: Find Shortest Path in Matrix
design: breadth-first search with a flat array queue over 8 neighbours

title: Find Shortest Unique Prefix
design: sort word indices; the answer length is 1 + the longer common prefix with the sorted neighbours

title: Find Size of Largest Subset
design: the AND is positive exactly when some bit is set in every chosen element, so count, per bit, how many elements have it and return the largest count

title: Find Smallest Hub
complexity: O(n + total intervals) time/O(1) extra space
design: one pass over hubs; skip hubs with too little capacity before parsing their intervals; keep the best (capacity, index)

title: Find Special Sequence Pairs
design: hash map of counts of earlier sequences; for each j add the count of its reverse complement, then record it

title: Find Text Before Stop Words (Variant 1)
complexity: O(W * |text|) worst time via native search/O(1) extra space
design: native indexOf per stop word, keep the minimum

title: Find Text Before Stop Words (Variant 2)
complexity: O(sum(chunk + 50) * W) time/O(sum stop lengths) space
design: pending buffer = held suffix + chunk; native search for stop words in pending; proper-prefix set for the hold

title: Find the K-th Highest Debit
complexity: O(L + P log P) time/O(P) space for L loans and P people
design: one pass accumulating nets in a hash map, then sort the positive entries by (-net, name)

title: Find the Most Common Ads (Variant 1)
complexity: O(n + d log k) time/O(d) space
design: hash count then bounded min-heap of size k keyed by (count, reverse adId), drained and reversed

title: Find the Most Common Ads (Variant 2)
complexity: O(n + d log k) time/O(d) space
design: parse and filter, hash count, size-k min-heap

title: Find the Nearest City
complexity: O((n + q) log n) time/O(n) space
design: group cities by x (sorted by y) and by y (sorted by x); a query only needs the adjacent entries in its two groups

title: Find Users with Valid Login Sessions
complexity: O(n + u log u) time/O(u) space
design: one pass with a hash map of open signin times and a set of valid users, then sort

title: Find Valid Sock Pairs (Variant 1)
design: hash counts per color, sum of min(left, right)

title: Find Valid Sock Pairs (Variant 2)
design: group by color, sort each side, zip, numeric sort by left id

title: Find Valid Tile Moves
design: multiset check then iterative forward DFS with visited set

title: Find Word Path
design: compute each letter's row and column arithmetically and emit the four run-length segments per letter in a list joined once

title: Fit Saved Rectangles in a Box
design: track max short side and max long side of saved rectangles; compare with sorted box sides

title: Flatten 2D Array With Remove
complexity: O(1) amortised per next/hasNext/remove, O(total) per getVector/O(total) space
design: copy the rows, keep a row and column cursor that skips empty rows, a per-row list of removed flags and the position of the last returned element; getVector rebuilds rows from the flags

title: Flatten HTML tags
complexity: O(total nodes) time, O(depth) extra space
design: explicit stack of (node, next child index); emit the open token on push and the close token on pop

title: Food Delivery System (Variant 1)
complexity: O(1) + O(offers of item) per query/O(menu) space
design: index item -> (lowest price, coordinate list of offering restaurants) once in the constructor; a query reads the price and scans only the offering restaurants

title: Food Delivery System (Variant 2)
complexity: O(offers of the rarest item * items) per order/O(menu) space
design: per-item index of restaurant -> price; an order starts from the item with the fewest offers and probes the other items' maps for each of its restaurants

title: Format a Task Hierarchy (Variant 1)
design: hash map id -> ordered child list plus a root list; iterative DFS with an explicit stack

title: Format a Task Hierarchy (Variant 2)
design: validate and deduplicate in one pass; child lists by parent; DFS from the roots so orphans and cycles are never reached

title: Format a Task Hierarchy (Variant 3)
design: level 2 structure; the DFS stack also carries the outline number string of each pending task

title: Format a Task Hierarchy (Variant 4)
design: level 3 structure plus a post-order pass over the displayed forest that computes each task's shown completion from its children

title: Format Articles Within Width
design: split each article into words and pack them greedily, joining each line's word slice once

title: Four-in-a-row Game
design: for each of the four directions count same-player pieces outward on both sides of the cell, stopping after three

title: Fractional Inventory
design: integer hundredths with ceil/floor division

title: Friend Recommendations by Mutual Friends
complexity: O(sum over users of sum of friend degrees) time/O(n+m) space
design: friend-of-friend counting with stamped arrays per user

title: Friends by Last-K Movie Overlap (Variant 1)
complexity: O(sum k log k) time/O(n k) space
design: canonical key = sorted distinct last-k movies joined by a separator; one hash map from key to member list in input order

title: Friends by Last-K Movie Overlap (Variant 2)
complexity: O(k) per watch, O(group size) per query/O(customers * k) space
design: per customer a queue of the last k movies, counts per movie and a sorted list of distinct movies maintained by binary insertion and removal; a map from key string to a sorted member list updated only when the set changes

title: Friendship and Balance Tracker
complexity: O(total request length) time/O(users + pending requests + friendships) space
design: hash maps for balances and pending requests keyed by sequence number, and a set of canonical friend-pair keys; each request is parsed by splitting on "/"

title: Fuel Station Queue Simulation
design: event arithmetic: keep each dispenser's free-at time and remaining fuel; a car starts at max(previous start, earliest free-at among dispensers with enough fuel) and picks the first such dispenser free at that time

title: Game Machine
design: prefix sums of costs and points; the stopping layer is non-decreasing in the start, so one moving pointer finds every stop

title: Garage Occupancy per Timestamp
design: difference array: +1 at entry and -1 at exit + 1, then a prefix sum

title: Generate Function Profiling Events (Variant 1)
design: incremental common-prefix diff of consecutive stacks with an open-frame stack; v2 buffered keyed events sorted once; v3 interval accumulation

title: Generate Function Profiling Events (Variant 2)
design: incremental common-prefix diff of consecutive stacks with an open-frame stack; v2 buffered keyed events sorted once; v3 interval accumulation

title: Generate Function Profiling Events (Variant 3)
design: incremental common-prefix diff of consecutive stacks with an open-frame stack; v2 buffered keyed events sorted once; v3 interval accumulation

title: Generate Random NFT (Variant 1)
design: direct modulo indexing

title: Generate Random NFT (Variant 2)
design: prefix sums per trait plus binary search (bisect_right)

title: Generate Random NFT (Variant 3)
design: virtual Fisher-Yates with a hash map of displaced positions; mixed-radix decoding

title: Generate Unique Usernames
complexity: O(n * 8) expected time beyond suffix probing/O(n) space
design: set of issued usernames plus a per-base counter remembering the last suffix tried, so repeated bases resume where they stopped

title: Get Total Requests
design: hash map from id to how many servers have it plus a running total; a day moves the count of replaced[j] to newId[j]

title: Gift Delivery Scheduler
complexity: O(m + 8 * 9) time/O(1) extra space for m recipients
design: earliest-deadline-first sweep over the eight hours, using a count of available recipients per end hour as the priority queue (end hours take only nine values)

title: GPU Credits
complexity: O(1) add/revoke, O(g) balance; O(g) space
design: hash map id -> [amount,start,end,revokedAt]; balance scans grants

title: GPU Credits II
complexity: O(E log E) per consume/balance query; O(E) space
design: per query: sort events by time, sweep with a min-heap keyed (end,start,id) and a running active total with lazy expiry

title: Grep With Context Lines (Variant 1)
design: one scan records match positions; a second scan keeps a "covered up to" index so each match extends the covered range to j + linesAround and starts it no earlier than j - linesAround, emitting each covered line once

title: Grep With Context Lines (Variant 2)
design: one scan of match positions with a "covered up to" index; a new block starts whenever the next covered range begins after the last emitted index + 1

title: Grid Coloring with Boundaries
design: BFS per region from a pre-coloured cell (or its first cell), alternating colours and checking every edge

title: Group Chat Mention Counter
design: single pass per message: split on spaces, parse "@" tokens, collect member indices in a per-message set, then increment

title: Group Elements by Shared Properties
design: union-find with path halving; a map per property position keeps the first element seen with each value and unions later elements into it; groups are collected by root, sorted and ordered by smallest id

title: Group Loans by Top-Level Company (Variant 1)
complexity: O((p + l) + l log l) time/O(p + l) space
design: iterative root find with memoized roots (path compression), hash grouping

title: Group Loans by Top-Level Company (Variant 2)
complexity: O(p + l + g log g) time/O(p + l) space
design: memoized iterative root find, hash totals, sort

title: Guess Number
design: digit counts in one array; per position, filler-padded probes; strings built once per guess

title: Guess Number II
complexity: O(log 1000) queries per target, O(1) work per query
design: C is always an interval [lo, hi]; each answer cuts it at the midpoint of the last two queries and drops the queried end

title: Guess Number with Delay (Variant 1)
design: interval arithmetic; the call count is two per round

title: Guess Number with Delay (Variant 2)
design: interval arithmetic; delay + 1 calls per round

title: High Correlation Seller
complexity: O(sum s_i^2 + S log S) time/O(pairs) space
design: dedupe sessions, nested hash counts over session pairs, per-store max

title: Highest Average Score
design: hash sum/count; compare means by integer cross-multiplication; exact floor division

title: Highest Earning Experience Tracker
design: max-heap of (total, name) snapshots with lazy deletion: every update pushes the new snapshot; a query pops snapshots whose total is no longer current

title: Highest Scoring Movie Group
complexity: O(G log k) time/O(k) extra space, G = total group size
design: per group, keep a size-k min-heap of scores (push, pop the smallest when larger than k) and sum the heap; compare totals with a strict greater-than so the first best index wins

title: Highlight Phrases in Review
complexity: O(review length * longest phrase + total phrase length)
design: trie of lower-cased phrases holding the first category; walk the trie from each word start, remembering the last node that ends a phrase at a word boundary

title: Highway Checkpoint
complexity: O(n log n) time for the final sort/O(n) space
design: one pass with a dictionary from plate to (last position, total); extract the number from each name by skipping its letters; sort the plates at the end

title: Hopscotch
complexity: O(n + total directive length) time/O(n) space
design: breadth-first search from start, parsing each cell's directives with a character scanner the first time the cell is dequeued

title: Hotel Booking Reminder (Variant 1)
design: generate triples then comparator sort (day, guest, touchpoint)

title: Hotel Booking Reminder (Variant 2)
design: generate triples then comparator sort (day, guest, touchpoint)

title: Hotel Booking Reminder (Variant 3)
design: generate triples then comparator sort (day, guest, touchpoint)

title: Implement Dataset Join Operation (Variant 1)
design: hash map from key value to the list of processor rows (kept in input order), then one pass over the customer rows

title: Implement Dataset Join Operation (Variant 2)
design: hash map from key value to the list of processor rows (kept in input order), then one pass over the customer rows; unmatched customer rows are padded with empty processor values

title: Implement Dataset Join Operation (Variant 3)
design: hash map from key value to the list of processor rows (kept in input order), then one pass over the customer rows; a matched flag per processor row selects the unmatched ones appended at the end

title: Implement Dataset Join Operation (Variant 4)
design: hash map from the tuple of key values (joined with a comma, which cannot occur in values) to the processor rows

title: Implement itoa()
complexity: O(d) time/O(d) space for d digits
design: peel decimal digits from the magnitude into a buffer, reverse, prepend the sign

title: Implement Simplified Git Diff (Variant 1)
design: two counting hash maps, first qualifying i

title: Implement Simplified Git Diff (Variant 2)
design: patience LIS on reversed order for suffix chain lengths; greedy smallest-index pick per length level via bisect

title: Implement Simplified Git Diff (Variant 3)
design: explicit work stack over segment bounds; per segment prefix/suffix trim, hash counts, DIFF2 chain routine

title: Incremental String Tokenizer
complexity: O(n log n + sum of token lengths) time/O(n) space
design: doubly linked sequence plus a lazy index from adjacent id pair to positions; per token enumerate its splits into two earlier tokens, sort the candidate positions and merge left to right with validity checks

title: Incremental Task Scheduler
complexity: O(reachable) per addTask, O((V + E) log V) per getExecutionOrder/O(V + E) space
design: adjacency maps in both directions; addTask runs an iterative depth-first search from id over existing dependents and rejects when it reaches a prerequisite; getExecutionOrder runs Kahn's algorithm with a binary min-heap of ids, counting only added prerequisites as satisfiable

title: Integer to English Converter (Variant 1)
design: lookup table of the ten digit words

title: Integer to English Converter (Variant 2)
design: tables for 1-19 and the tens; hundreds digit then the remainder below 100

title: Integer to English Converter (Variant 3)
design: three-digit chunks from the low end, each converted with the level 2 helper and suffixed with its scale word; empty chunks skipped

title: Interleave Iterator with Cycle
complexity: O(k) construction for k arrays; amortised O(1) per call
design: queue of (array index, position) cursors over non-empty arrays; pop, emit, re-append if more remain; when cycling refill the queue once it empties

title: IP CIDR Firewall
design: pre-parse rules into (mask, masked base, allow) 32-bit integers; first-match scan

title: IP Routing Lookup
complexity: O(R + Q * L) time for L distinct lengths (<= 33)/O(R) space
design: one hash map per prefix length from the masked network number to the next hop (later entries overwrite); a query probes the present lengths from longest to shortest

title: IPO Share Allocation
design: group by price descending; a partial level allots one share to the first `remaining` bidders by timestamp

title: Iterator with Filter
complexity: O(1) amortised per call/O(1) extra space
design: lazy cursor: hasNext advances an index past rejected elements and caches the position of the next selected one; next returns it and moves on

title: Jaccard Business Similarity
design: hash sets of words; the rounded hundredths are (200 c + u) div (2 u) in integer arithmetic, then divided by 100 once

title: Job Scheduler
design: min-heap of busy (end, machine) and min-heap of free machine numbers; release finished machines before each assignment

title: Jump Game Prime
complexity: O(n * P) time for P such primes below n/O(n) space
design: sieve the primes ending in 3 below n; dp[i] = nums[i] + max(dp[i-1], dp[i-p]) over those primes

title: Jumping by Height
design: simulate while recording visited (position, direction) states in a hash set; a repeated state means an endless walk

title: Keyboard Jump Challenge
design: per step, a two-pass L1 distance transform of the reachable cells gives each cell its distance to the nearest reachable cell

title: Keypad Letter Combination
complexity: O(results * length) time/O(length) extra space beyond the output
design: iterative backtracking over positions that tries group sizes in increasing order; the letter grows with the group size, so the output comes out already sorted

title: Knight Paths on a Phone Keypad
complexity: O(number of shortest paths * path length)
design: BFS distances from start, then DFS that only follows edges increasing the distance by one and ends at end

title: Kth Greatest in Growing Prefix
design: size-k min-heap of the largest values seen; its top is the answer

title: KV Store with Prefix Search
complexity: O(|key|) per set/update/delete, O(1) per get, O(|prefix| + matched subtree) per prefixSearch/O(total key length) space
design: trie with per-node live-key counts and pruning on delete, plus a hash map for get; prefixSearch walks to the prefix node and runs an iterative depth-first search visiting children in letter order

title: Largest Common BST Value
complexity: O(n1 + n2) time/O(n1 + n2) space for decoding plus O(h1 + h2) stacks
design: decode each level-order array into child index arrays, then walk both trees in reverse in-order with explicit stacks, advancing the side holding the larger value until the values meet

title: Largest Consecutive Skill Team
design: count each skill; from every level whose predecessor is absent walk upward summing counts

title: Largest Group of Mutual Strangers
design: tree dynamic programming over an iterative depth-first order: for each person the best group size with and without that person, combined bottom-up per component

title: Largest K Elements in Sliding Window
complexity: O(n * (log w + w_move) + output) time with array moves done by the runtime/O(w) space
design: keep the window as a sorted array, inserting the entering element and removing the leaving one by binary search; read the last k entries backwards

title: Largest Number by Parity Swaps
design: one pass splitting maximal same-parity runs; counting sort of each run in descending order

title: Largest Rectangle Area (Variant 1)
complexity: O(n log n + sum over columns of size^2) time/O(n^2) space
design: sort by x and sweep columns; for every pair of y values in a column, remember the first column containing both and score the rectangle from that column to the current one

title: Largest Rectangle Area (Variant 2)
complexity: O(n^2 + sum over groups of size^2) time/O(n^2) space
design: group all point pairs by (midpoint sum, squared length): two diagonals in the same group form a rectangle, scored as the absolute cross product of the sides from one corner

title: Largest Tree Root
design: children adjacency, iterative DFS from each root

title: Latency Bucket Counter
design: integer division per latency, capped at the last bucket (sortedness is not needed)

title: League Earnings
design: closed form: total = sum over clubs of capacity * ((c-1) * own trophies + (S - own trophies)); average from integer quotient and remainder

title: Level Order Task Scheduling
complexity: O((n + m) + n log n) time/O(n + m) space
design: Kahn's algorithm processed level by level: in-degree counts, the current frontier sorted, successors whose in-degree drops to 0 form the next frontier

title: Level With Maximum Nodes in an N-ary Tree
design: parse the level-order list once, counting nodes per level breadth-first; keep the first level whose count beats the best so far

title: Limit Tree Height by Deletions (Variant 1)
design: iterative DFS carrying the count of kept nodes on the path

title: Limit Tree Height by Deletions (Variant 2)
design: post-order subtree heights; count non-root nodes whose subtree height is at least maxHeight (kept sets are unions of maxHeight-1 height layers under the root)

title: Linear Interpolation
complexity: O((n + q) log n) time/O(n) space
design: group points by x keeping min and max y, sort distinct x, binary search each query, integer numerator and denominator reduced by gcd

title: Linear Interpolation of Missing Points
design: integer numerator (y2-y1)*(x-x1) over the gap, reduced by gcd, added to y1

title: Linked User Records by Similarity (Variant 1)
complexity: O(n^2 + n * fields) time/O(n * fields) space
design: convert weights and threshold to integer ten-thousandths; bucket rows by (field, value) so each row adds its shared-field weights to a score array of later rows, then scan the array against the threshold

title: Linked User Records by Similarity (Variant 2)
complexity: O(n^2 alpha(n) + n * fields) time/O(n * fields) space
design: integer-scaled weights and bucketed score accumulation as in level 1, joining linked rows in a union-find with path halving; collect members per root in row order

title: Linked User Records by Similarity (Variant 3)
complexity: O(n^2 + n * fields) time/O(n * fields) space
design: integer-scaled weights; for each row accumulate scores against all rows through the value buckets, then scan once for the highest linked score with the earliest row

title: Live Fraud Detector (Variant 1)
complexity: O(1) per event and query/O(distinct) space
design: hash set insert per field

title: Live Fraud Detector (Variant 2)
complexity: O(1) per event and query/O(distinct) space
design: hash map value -> event count, running shared counter incremented on the 1 -> 2 transition

title: Load Factor Calculation
complexity: O(V log V + E) time/O(V + E) space
design: Kahn topological order with a queue over the whole graph, pushing each service's load to its callees once its own load is final; sort names at the end

title: Longest Circular Sequence of Ones
design: if zeros <= k answer n; otherwise a sliding window over the doubled array (windows then never exceed n)

title: Longest Common Subsequence-Substring
design: DP over (prefix of x, end position in y): dp[i][j] = longest substring of y ending at j that is a subsequence of x[:i]; one rolling row

title: Longest Consecutive Segment After Insertions
design: hash map from each run endpoint to its run length; a built house extends the run ending at p - 1 or the run starting at p + 1 (never both, by the build rule)

title: Longest Prefix And Suffix
design: KMP prefix function; the answer is its last value

title: Longest Semi-Alternating Substring
design: one pass: a window start that jumps to i - 1 whenever s[i-2..i] are equal

title: Longest Subarray Under Limit
design: two-pointer window: extend right, shrink left while the sum exceeds k

title: Longest Valid Parentheses
design: one stack pass: each open frame remembers its position and the highest rank of pairs closed inside it; a matching closer with an allowed rank pops the frame and measures back to the next frame or the last barrier, anything else resets the stack at a barrier

title: Lowercase Before Uppercase Count
design: one pass recording the last lowercase index and first uppercase index per letter

title: Make Array Bitonic
design: the largest peak at c is min(c + 1, n - c, min over i of arr[i] + |i - c|); compute the inner minimum with one left-to-right and one right-to-left pass and subtract the best k * k from sum(arr)

title: Make Power Non-decreasing
design: every drop power[i - 1] > power[i] needs operations starting at i worth at least the drop, and raising suffixes achieves exactly that; sum the drops

title: Margin Call (Variant 1)
design: hash map symbol -> shares and integer cash; sort the held symbols once at the end

title: Margin Call (Variant 2)
design: max-heap of (latest price, symbol) with lazy invalidation; sell ceil(deficit / price) shares of the best symbol at once, capped by its holding

title: Margin Call (Variant 3)
design: heap as in level 2; when the best is an option whose stock is better, sell in closed form: options alone until the counts are equal, then option/stock pairs

title: Match Cyclic Shift to Descending Sequence
design: count cyclic ascents nums[i] < nums[i+1 mod n]: none -> 0; exactly one at i -> t = (n - (i+1)) mod n; more -> -1

title: Match Payment to Invoice (Variant 1)
design: hash map of invoice ids; manual substring search for the marker

title: Match Payment to Invoice (Variant 2)
complexity: O(P*L + I log I) time/O(I) space
design: per-amount buckets sorted by (dueDate, id) with advancing pointers skipping matched ids

title: Matrix Escape
design: multi-source BFS for threat times from every P, then a BFS from U that enters a cell only when its arrival minute is below the threat time; stop at the first border cell

title: Matrix Transformation with Commands
complexity: O(n * m + commands) time/O(n * m) space for the output
design: keep a row order permutation and one reversed flag per original row; a swap exchanges two permutation entries and a reversal flips a flag, then build the result once at the end

title: Matrix Transpose with Workers
design: contiguous row blocks per simulated worker writing a preallocated output

title: Max Consecutive ON Servers
design: sliding window over the string tracking the number of zero blocks that start inside it; advance the left edge past a whole block when the count exceeds k

title: Max Fly Distance
design: dynamic programming over days with one best distance per energy level 0..k (unreachable levels marked), or the plain sum when k >= n

title: Max Levels from Each Index
design: prefix sums: level j passes from start i exactly when prefix[j + 1] + energy[j] <= K + prefix[i]; with non-negative layers the first failing level never moves left as i grows, so a second pointer finds it

title: Max Matrix Border Distinct Sum
design: per square, walk only the 4k - 4 border cells into a hash set

title: Max Non-overlapping Tasks
design: sort by end; take a task when its start is at least the last taken end

title: Max Square from Mixed Tiles
design: feasibility is monotone within each parity of s; binary search the largest even and the largest odd side and take the larger

title: Max Sum Between Leaf Nodes
design: iterative post-order: best downward leaf path per node; nodes with two children combine both sides

title: Maximize Deployment Score
design: with sorted order v1 <= ... <= vn the optimum is (vn - v1) + max(v(n-1) - v1, vn - v2); found from the two smallest and two largest values

title: Maximize Edge Sum in Graph
complexity: O(n log n + m) time/O(n) space
design: the value equals sum(label(v) * degree(v)); sort degrees ascending and give label i to the i-th smallest degree (rearrangement inequality)

title: Maximize Hole in Prison Gate
complexity: O(h log h + v log v) time/O(h+v) space
design: sort removed bars, longest consecutive run

title: Maximize Negative Signs
design: scan left to right, tentatively negate every element and push it on a max-heap; while the running sum is not positive, flip the largest negated value back to plus; the heap size at the end is the answer

title: Maximize Number With K Swaps
design: greedy: scan left to right and replace digits below 5 while operations remain

title: Maximize Portfolio Floor Value
design: binary search the floor T in [min(values), min(values) + totalCost]; feasibility sums (T - v) * c with an early exit

title: Maximize Server Throughput
design: sort descending; with c = floor(N / 3) groups the medians are the values at positions 1, 3, ..., 2c - 1 (each group takes two large values and one of the c smallest)

title: Maximize Task Scheduling Within Time Limit
complexity: O(t log t) time/O(t) space, t = number of tasks
design: sort the durations and keep the slot end times in a min-heap of size min(n * m, number of tasks); pop the earliest, stop when it plus the duration exceeds 60, otherwise push the new end time

title: Maximum Balanced Task Assignment
design: count each type with a hash map; a type can serve at most min(count, m) nodes, and t per node is feasible exactly when the sum of min(count, m) is at least m * t (the counting function is concave), so t = floor(sum / m)

title: Maximum Bounded XOR
design: bitwise DP from the top bit over tightness flags for a and b against lo and hi, tightness of the XOR against k and an a < b flag; greedy 1 bits first

title: Maximum Building Height
design: one multi-source BFS from all P tiles through non-X tiles; take the largest distance and check every building tile was reached

title: Maximum Combination Health
design: hash map series -> total health; a min-heap of size k keeps the k largest totals

title: Maximum Concurrent Calls
complexity: O(n log n + output) time/O(n) space
design: per customer sort +1/-1 events (ends before starts at equal times), sweep; each constant segment updates the maximum of every day it covers

title: Maximum Distinct Split Sum
design: prefix distinct counts left to right and suffix distinct counts right to left

title: Maximum Grid Jumping Path (Variant 1)
design: row-by-row dynamic programme of the best sum reaching each cell from (0, p), with unreachable cells marked, then the maximum over the bottom row

title: Maximum Grid Jumping Path (Variant 2)
design: dynamic programme over (row, column, jumps used): best sum reaching each state, filled row by row from the one-row moves of row i - 1 and the jumps of row i - 2

title: Maximum Grid Jumping Path (Variant 3)
design: backward dynamic programme of the best sum from (i, j) with r jumps left to the bottom row; then walk forward from (0, p), at each step taking the first move in cell order (down-left, down, down-right, jump) whose state keeps the optimum

title: Maximum Grid Jumping Path (Variant 4)
design: forward dynamic programme over (row, column, jumps used) storing (best sum, number of paths with that sum mod 1000000007); merge predecessors by keeping the larger sum and adding counts on equal sums, then merge the bottom-row states the same way

title: Maximum Interval Overlap Count
design: sort starts and ends separately and sweep, consuming a start before an end at the same coordinate because intervals are closed

title: Maximum Island Perimeter
design: iterative DFS counting exposed edges per island

title: Maximum Multiplier Path
design: dynamic programming over visited-node bitmasks: best[mask][v] is the largest product of a simple path from start that visits exactly mask and ends at v

title: Maximum Number of Balanced Shipments
design: a shipment ending at i is balanced exactly when it starts at or before g(i), the nearest earlier index with a larger weight (monotonic stack); best[i + 1] = 1 + max(best[0..g(i)]), using a running prefix maximum of best

title: Maximum Profit Query Selection
design: one pass computing floor(k / time) * profit with a strict improvement test

title: Maximum Ski Score
design: topological order of the part reachable from the lodge (Kahn); DP of the best score to finish from each node, computed in reverse topological order

title: Maximum Sprint Points Sum
design: some optimal window ends on the last day of a sprint; over the doubled sprint list, prefix sums of days and of triangular sums plus a moving left pointer give each such window in O(1)

title: Maximum Stability
design: sort servers by availability descending and keep a running reliability sum; candidate = availability * running sum

title: Maximum Task Rewards
design: sort by deadline; min-heap of chosen profits, popping the smallest whenever the heap outgrows the deadline

title: Maximum Testing Efficiency
design: sort, group equal times, Kadane over distinct times: best ending at t_j = c_j + max(0, best ending at t_{j-1} - gap)

title: Maximum Throughput
design: binary search on the target T; upgrades needed for service i are ceil(T/throughput[i])-1; sum costs with early exit

title: Maximum Vacation With Minimum Flights
design: week-by-week DP keeping (days, flights) per city; the best flight into city c comes from the best other city, so keep the top two previous cities and compare lexicographically

title: Maximum Value of Valid Expression Path
design: DP in row-major order: best value ending at each digit cell; an operator cell carries the best value of its digit predecessors

title: Merge Common Substring
design: KMP prefix function of str2 + separator + the last min(len) characters of str1; the final value is L

title: Merge JSON Event Logs
design: k-way merge with a min-heap keyed by (time, serverId, position), one head per server

title: Merge K Sorted Price Streams
design: k-way merge with a min-heap of (timestamp, stream, index); aggregate equal timestamps

title: Merge N-ary Tree
design: parse both lists into child-index arrays, then walk aligned node pairs breadth-first (either side may be missing) and write the merged level-order list directly

title: Merge Two Interval Lists
design: two pointers take the interval with the smaller start next and extend or close the current merged interval

title: Merge Unique Arrays
design: two pointers over both arrays, appending a value only when it differs from the last appended one

title: Merge Values into Blocks
design: one pass with the last occurrence index of every value; a piece ends where the furthest last occurrence seen so far equals the current index

title: Min Root-to-Leaf Path Sum of N-ary Tree
design: parse the level-order list breadth-first, giving each node its path sum from its parent, and take the minimum over leaves

title: Minimal Board Length for Holes
design: sort; the answer is max(1, min over split points i of max(a[i] - a[0], a[n-1] - a[i+1])), or max(1, 0) when all holes fit one board

title: Minimal Difference in Two Arrays
design: two pointers over both sorted lists find the minimum difference d; a second merge pass walks A in ascending order and, for each a, advances a pointer in B to the first value >= a - d, returning the first a for which a - d or a + d is present

title: Minimal Video Score Reduction
complexity: O(n log max) time/O(1) extra space
design: binary search x over [1, max score]; the operation count sum(ceil(s / x)) over positive scores is non-increasing in x

title: Minimize a Convex Function
complexity: O(lines * log((b - a) / eps)) time, O(1) extra space
design: binary search for the first grid index j with F(x_j) <= F(x_{j+1}) (convexity makes the grid sequence unimodal), O(lines) per evaluation

title: Minimize Capital Gains Tax
design: max-heap of [price, remaining amount] lots; a sell pops or reduces the top lots

title: Minimize Cost with Vouchers
complexity: O(n + v log n) time for v = min(vouchersCount, useful halvings)/O(n) space
design: max-heap of current prices; repeatedly halve the largest price until vouchers run out or the largest price is 0

title: Minimize Shopping Department Visits
design: hash map from product name to department, then a set of departments over the shopping list

title: Minimum Absolute Difference Pairs
design: sort a copy, take the minimum adjacent gap, then collect adjacent pairs with that gap

title: Minimum Batteries for Call Duration
complexity: O(n log n) time, O(n) space
design: prefix sums of usage; in steady state battery i is idle for (total usage - usage[i]) minutes, so feasibility after the first pass is one check per battery; full passes are counted arithmetically and the last partial pass by binary search on the prefix sums

title: Minimum Coin Combination Counts
design: suffix tables f_i[a] = fewest coins for amount a using the i-th largest denomination and smaller ones (unbounded knapsack per denomination), then reconstruct from the largest denomination taking the largest count t with f_{i+1}[a - t * c] = f_i[a] - t

title: Minimum Coins to Form All Amounts
complexity: O(k log k) time/O(k) space, k = number of denominations
design: greedy on sorted distinct denominations: repeatedly add the largest coin not above reachable + 1, jumping many identical picks at once with integer division

title: Minimum Device Procurement Cost
design: the cost is convex piecewise linear in the bundle count, so evaluate it at 0, min(x, y) and max(x, y)

title: Minimum Distance in N-ary Tree (Variant 1)
design: iterative DFS recording parent and depth of every node, then lift the deeper node and walk both up to their lowest common ancestor

title: Minimum Distance in N-ary Tree (Variant 2)
design: multi-source BFS over the undirected tree started from all of groupA at once, stopping at the first node of groupB

title: Minimum Distance to All Points
design: sort a copy; the lower median sorted[(n - 1) // 2] is the smallest minimiser, and its total distance is one pass

title: Minimum Expected Asset Cost
design: integer DP over numerators with common denominator m**i (m = b - a + 1); each state sums the min over all prices with one threshold split and arithmetic series, exact big integers

title: Minimum Flips for Grid Symmetry
design: visit each orbit {(i, j), (i, M-1-j), (N-1-i, j), (N-1-i, M-1-j)} once from its top-left representative, count B among its distinct cells and add min(B, size - B)

title: Minimum Idleness After K Flips
complexity: O(n log n) time/O(1) extra space
design: binary search the answer L: L = 1 needs min(mismatches against "abab...", against "baba...") flips; for L >= 2 a run of length r needs floor(r / (L + 1)) flips

title: Minimum Machines for Task Scheduling
design: sort the starts and the ends separately and sweep: at equal times process ends before starts, tracking the running count and its maximum

title: Minimum Menu Order Cost I (Variant 1)
design: bitmask DP over covered wanted items: dp[mask | entryMask] = min(dp[mask] + price), masks in increasing order

title: Minimum Menu Order Cost I (Variant 2)
design: the level-1 bitmask DP over lexicographic (price, count) pairs

title: Minimum Menu Order Cost II
complexity: O(2**w * entries) time plus output size
design: memoised DFS on the remaining-item mask that always covers the lowest remaining item; best[mask] gives the minimum, then a second DFS enumerates only branches that stay on the optimum

title: Minimum Nondecreasing Increment
design: every descent i forces i+1 chosen and i unchosen; x = max descent; reject adjacent forced indices or a forced index overtaking its right neighbour

title: Minimum Operations to Reduce to Zero
design: greedy on the low bits: halve when even; for odd n, decrement when n is 1 or 3 or n % 4 == 1, else increment

title: Minimum Operations to Sort by Rotate and Flip
design: BFS over the 2n dihedral states (offset, flipped) without materialising arrays; goal states read from the position of the minimum

title: Minimum Redistribution Cost
design: prefix sums of products[i] - average; clockwise cost = sum(prefix) - n * min(prefix), counterclockwise cost = n * max(prefix) - sum(prefix); return the smaller

title: Minimum Root Edges Reversal
design: one iterative traversal from node 1 for its cost, then re-rooting: moving the root across an edge changes the cost by +1 or -1 depending on the edge direction

title: Minimum Root-to-Leaf Path Sum
design: decode the level-order list into child index arrays, run an iterative preorder walk carrying prefix sums and parent indices, keep the first leaf with a strictly smaller sum, then rebuild its path from parents

title: Minimum Starting Battery Level
design: one pass tracking the largest prefix sum P of usage; the answer is max(1, P + 1)

title: Minimum Steps to Reorder Layers
design: n minus the longest prefix of current whose desired positions are strictly increasing (untouched elements form such a prefix)

title: Minimum Subarray with K Unique Integers
design: sliding window with a hash map of counts: extend the right end, and while the window has at least k distinct values record its length and shrink from the left

title: Minimum Swaps for Ball Grouping
complexity: O(n) time, O(number of red balls) space
design: shift red position i by i and move the block to the median of the shifted positions; sum absolute differences

title: Minimum Swaps to Group Evens First
design: count the evens E; the answer is the number of odd values among the first E positions

title: Minimum Triggers to Absorb All Balls
design: sort by (x, y) and by (y, x); union consecutive balls on the same line within d; count roots

title: Minimum Variant Conversion
design: closed form c + m(m-1)/2, where c counts ones and m is the smallest positive k-window sum (clear that window first, then every other 1 costs 1)

title: Minimum Vertices to Traverse Directed Graph
design: iterative Tarjan strongly connected components, then count components with no incoming edge from another component

title: MinMax Queue
design: an array queue with a head index plus two monotonic deques (non-decreasing for min, non-increasing for max) with head indices; dequeue drops the deque fronts equal to the leaving value

title: Monster Team Battle (Variant 1)
design: index pointers to the current front monster of each team and copied health arrays; one log line per event

title: Monster Team Battle (Variant 2)
design: index pointers per team, copied health arrays, damage from attack and defense

title: Monster Team Battle (Variant 3)
design: index pointers per team; each round orders the two fronts by speed and performs one or two attacks

title: Monsters Battle (Variant 1)
design: one iterative post-order pass counting hostile monsters strictly below each node; a node qualifies when the count equals the total

title: Monsters Battle (Variant 2)
design: tree DP: need[u] = min(cost(u) if u is non-hostile, sum over children c of need[c] or infinity when c is hostile), with need[u] = 0 when no hostile is strictly below u

title: Most Frequent Call Chain
design: trie of chains: each call moves to the child node (parent, name), counts per node, best tracked online

title: Most Frequent Substring
design: one pass counting every window in a hash map, then a scan for the best (count, string)

title: MultiStream Reader
design: queue of Stream objects plus a pending buffer; pulls fixed-size chunks through Stream.read

title: Multithreaded Array Sort
complexity: O(n log n) time, O(n) space
design: split into k near-equal segments, sort each copy, then merge pairs of runs round by round until one remains

title: Music Player (Variant 1)
complexity: O(1) add/play; O(S log S) getAnalytics
design: per-song set of users; sort songs by (-count, id) per analytics call

title: Music Player (Variant 2)
complexity: O(1) play; O(1) getLastThreeSongs; O(S log S) getAnalytics
design: per-user recency list (linked by song id, move-to-front on play); per-song user sets

title: Music Player (Variant 3)
complexity: O(1) play/remove; amortised O(1) getLastThreeSongs; O(S log S) getAnalytics
design: per-user recency list with lazy unlinking of removed songs; removed flag per song

title: N-ary Tree Leaf Node Removal
complexity: O(n log n) time for the sorts/O(n) space
design: decode into child lists, compute each node's height (leaves 0) in reverse breadth-first order, and bucket values by height; sort each bucket

title: N-gram Split (Variant 1)
design: hash set of bigram strings; one left-to-right pass

title: N-gram Split (Variant 2)
design: word trie of the dictionary; walk forward up to 5 words and keep the longest terminal

title: Neighborhood Party Interval Aggregator (Variant 1)
design: group by neighborhood, sort windows by start, single merge pass

title: Neighborhood Party Interval Aggregator (Variant 2)
design: per neighborhood sweep over sorted start/end events (ends before starts at equal hours)

title: Nested Set Equality
complexity: O(N log N) time over all elements
design: iterative post-order hash-consing: every atom and every list gets an integer id; a list's key is its sorted distinct child ids

title: Nested String with Brackets Parsing (Variant 1)
design: one left-to-right scan with an open-parenthesis counter; fail when it drops below 0, succeed when it ends at 0

title: Nested String with Brackets Parsing (Variant 2)
design: iterative stack parser: "(" pushes a new array, letters accumulate into a word that is flushed on "," or ")", and ")" pops the finished array into its parent

title: Newspaper Text Alignment
design: running line length with one pass over the words; pad with repeat

title: Next Consonant Transformation
complexity: O(n) time/O(n) space for the output
design: precompute a 26-entry table (vowels map to themselves, each consonant to the next consonant cyclically) and map every character through it, joining once

title: Next Greater Palindrome
design: mirror the left half onto the right; if the result is not greater than n, add one to the left half (including the middle digit) with carry and mirror again; all nines become 1 0...0 1

title: Non-connected People Pairs
design: union-find with union by size and path halving; answer = n(n-1)/2 minus the sum of s(s-1)/2 over group sizes s

title: Non-Consecutive Process Scheduling
design: closed form k*(k-1)^(n-1) by modular square-and-multiply (BigInt in JavaScript)

title: Number of Idle Drives
design: hash maps from x to the min and max y on that column and from y to the min and max x on that row; a robot is idle when it is strictly inside both ranges

title: Object Field Offset Manager
complexity: O(log m) per operation/O(m) space, m = fields ever added
design: Fenwick tree over append slots holding sizes (0 once removed) plus a name-to-slot map; getOffset is a prefix sum, fieldAt a Fenwick descent

title: Obstacle Placement and Block Check
design: offline: compress the placed positions, then for each check binary-search the obstacle positions in the range and count the ones already placed with a Fenwick tree

title: Offset Commit
design: hash set of completed offsets and a pointer to the next uncommitted offset that only moves forward

title: Oldest One-Time Visitor
design: a login counter per username plus a queue of first logins with a head index; a query drops queue heads whose count exceeds 1

title: One-Hot Encoding of An Array
complexity: O(n log n + n * d) time/O(n * d) space for the output, d = distinct values
design: sort the distinct values once, map each value to its column index with a hash map, then build each row as zeros with a single 1

title: Optimal Stock Price Subsequence
design: dp[j] = price[j] + max(0, best dp over earlier keys <= key[j]) with key = price + index; a prefix-maximum Fenwick tree over compressed keys

title: Optimal Team Selection
complexity: O(n log n) time/O(1) extra space
design: binary search the team size k; a size is feasible when a left-to-right greedy takes developer i whenever taken-so-far <= lowerSkill[i] and k - 1 - taken-so-far <= higherSkill[i], reaching k

title: Optimize Transition from Elevator to Stairs
complexity: O(log n + n^2) worst case time/O(1) space
design: feasibility is monotone in k, so binary search the smallest feasible k (k * e1 - (n - k - 1) * e2 > 0, or k = n); scan k upward from there, cutting a stair walk off once it reaches the best time and stopping when k * t1 + (n - k) alone reaches the best, since every stair floor costs at least 1

title: Organization Report Chain (Variant 1)
design: iterative explicit-stack pre-order DFS over a name->children map

title: Organization Report Chain (Variant 2)
design: iterative pre-order then reverse-order subtree size accumulation

title: Organization Report Chain (Variant 3)
design: report->manager map, walk upward, reverse

title: Organization Report Chain (Variant 4)
design: depths by upward walk, then lift the deeper one and step both upward together

title: Organize Books to Shelves
design: shelf counts stay non-increasing by index, so the target is the first shelf whose count equals count[limit - 1]; keep the first index of every count value and move it by one per book

title: Palindrome Check with Ignore Set
design: a set of ignored characters and two pointers moving inward, skipping ignored characters

title: Palindrome Stream Tracker
complexity: O(1) amortised per track and O(1) per query/O(n) space
design: palindromic tree (eertree) maintained per appended character; the stream is a palindrome exactly when its longest palindromic suffix is the whole stream (exact, no hashing)

title: Palindromic Storage Paths
design: root-to-node parity masks P; the path q..v has mask P[q] xor P[parent(v)]; an iterative DFS keeps counts of the masks of the strict ancestors (plus 0 for v = root) and looks up P[q] and its 26 one-bit neighbours

title: Pandigital Sum
complexity: O(9!) worst case, far fewer with column pruning/O(1) space
design: backtracking column by column from the units digit with the carry, so the sum digit is forced at each column

title: Partition Array by Equivalence Function
complexity: O((n + p) alpha(n + p)) time/O(n + p) space, p = pairs
design: union-find keyed by value with path halving and union by size; one pass over nums assigns group indices to roots in first-seen order

title: Pascal Triangle Encryption
complexity: O(L log L) time, O(1) extra space
design: the final digits are sums of binomial coefficients C(L - 2, i) times the digits, mod 10; C mod 2 and mod 5 by Lucas' theorem, combined by CRT

title: Payment Refund Allocation
design: one pass summing refunds per linked payment in a hash map, one sort of the payments by (type rank, -timestamp, id), greedy allocation that stops once nothing remains

title: Persistent Stack
design: versions are nodes of a parent-pointer linked list kept in parallel arrays (parent, value, size); push appends a node, pop returns the parent

title: Phone Number Word Matching
design: letter-to-digit table; compare the word's digit string with phoneNumber

title: Pig Latin Sentence Converter
design: split on single spaces, transform each word with slicing, join

title: Pin Board Connectivity (Variant 1)
complexity: O(P alpha(P)) time/O(P) space for P total pins
design: union-find over pins, joining each board's pins to its first pin; compare the roots of pin1 and pin2

title: Pin Board Connectivity (Variant 2)
complexity: O(P) time/O(P) space for P total pins
design: breadth-first search over the pin-board bipartite graph from pin1; each board is expanded once, and its distance is the number of boards used

title: Pivot Table Profit Analyzer
design: parse amounts to integer cents, hash-map aggregation, sorted keys, cents formatting

title: Poker Hand Game Checker (Variant 1)
design: rank-count signature plus flush/straight flags

title: Poker Hand Game Checker (Variant 2)
design: one strength tuple per hand from the rank-count signature; single max scan

title: Poker Straight Sequence Check
design: map the values to ranks, then test max - min == 4 with the ace as 1, and again with the ace as 14

title: Portfolio Value Optimization
design: order indices by S / P with integer cross-multiplication, buy whole lots while affordable, buy the remaining fraction of the next one, and round the exact value I + r S / P with integer (BigInt in JavaScript) arithmetic

title: Prefix Frequency Partition
complexity: O(26 * n * d(n)/L summed over divisors) <= O(26 * sigma(n)) time/O(26n) space
design: per-letter prefix counts; for every divisor L compare each block's 26 counts with the prefix counts, stopping at the first mismatch

title: Prefix Search I
complexity: O(total characters + m log k) time/O(m) space
design: scan each name once for its first matching word, keep the best k (position, name) keys with heapq.nsmallest / a bounded selection, then order them

title: Prefix Search II
complexity: O(total characters + sum over queries of matches log matches) time/O(total characters) space
design: a trie over the lower-cased words storing (name, word index) at each node; walk searchWord down the trie and, per node, keep the smallest word index per name, then sort

title: Prefix to Postfix
design: scan left to right with a stack of pending operators and a count of finished operands for each; emit operands immediately and emit an operator when its second operand finishes, cascading upward; output collected in a list and joined once

title: Price Percentile Cutoff
design: combine counts in a map, sort distinct prices, cumulative scan with exact integer comparison

title: Print Employee Org Chart
design: group reports per manager in input order, then an iterative depth-first traversal with an explicit stack of (employee, depth), appending dash prefixes and names to a list joined once

title: Print Folder Path Given Node ID
design: parent map from child id to parent id, then walk up from targetId and reverse

title: Priority Expiry LRU Cache
complexity: O(log n) amortised per operation/O(n + operations) space
design: hash map of items plus two lazy min-heaps keyed by (expiryTime, access stamp) and (priority, access stamp); stale heap entries are skipped by comparing the stored stamp

title: Process Queue
design: count processes by wait value (capped at n), keep a front pointer that skips processed or expired entries, and update the alive count in O(1) amortised per second

title: Product of Maximum and Minimum
design: min-heap and max-heap with lazy deletion against occurrence counts

title: Product Price Query System
complexity: O((n + q) log n) time/O(n) space
design: parse once from the right, group by item, sort each item's dates, answer each query by binary search

title: Product Price Tracker
complexity: O(log u) amortised per call/O(u) space, u = updates
design: dictionary plus a max-heap and a min-heap of (price, timestamp) with lazy deletion of stale entries and a running latest timestamp

title: Property Booking System
complexity: O(C(m, s) * s) per booking for m free properties in the neighborhood/O(p) space
design: free properties per neighborhood sorted by id; the smallest feasible size comes from the largest capacities; backtracking over combinations of that size in id order keeps the first one with the smallest total

title: Purchase Optimization
complexity: O((n + q) log n) time/O(n) space
design: prefix sums; upper-bound binary search for prefix[pos-1]+amount

title: Pythagorean Triples
design: three BFS passes from x, y, z

title: Query Log  Matching
complexity: O(total words + postings touched) time/O(total words) space
design: inverted index word->query ids with per-log hit counters compared to distinct query word counts

title: Racing Points and Winner (Variant 1)
design: one pass adding 15/10/5 points into a hash map, then one scan for the highest total with the smallest name

title: Racing Points and Winner (Variant 2)
complexity: O(entries + r log r) time/O(riders) space
design: one pass building [points, firsts, seconds, thirds] per rider, then one sort by (-points, -firsts, -seconds, -thirds, name)

title: Random User Pairing (Variant 1)
design: index array pool with swap-with-last removal; each draw is O(1)

title: Random User Pairing (Variant 2)
design: queue of members per group in input order and a max-heap keyed by (-unpaired count, group name); pop two, pair, push back non-empty groups

title: Randomly Partition Array
design: Fisher-Yates swaps on a copy of nums, then k slices of length n / k

title: Range Iterator
design: keep only the current value; hasNext compares it with end in the direction of step

title: Range Negate Data Updates
design: parity difference array then one prefix pass

title: Rank Songs by Popularity
complexity: O(n m + m^2 log m) time/O(m^2) space
design: an m x m count table indexed by (song, position), then one sort of song ids by (negated count row, id)

title: Rank Vehicles by Contribution
complexity: O(total chunk ids + v log v) time/O(v) space
design: one pass counting chunk ids per sender into a hash map (registering receivers with 0), then one sort by (-contribution, id)

title: Reach End in Grid With Teleports
design: hash map from entrance cell index to exit cell index, a visited byte array, and a single walk that stops on the destination, a block, or a revisit

title: Realtime Bot IP Detection
design: per-IP queue of timestamps; drop entries older than timestamp - windowSeconds + 1 from the front, then compare the queue length with maxRequests

title: Rearrange Houses in Neighborhoods
complexity: O(N log D) time/O(D) space for N houses and D distinct numbers
design: a max-heap of (remaining copies, number); each neighborhood pops its size many entries, records the numbers sorted, and pushes back the ones with copies left

title: Recipes From Ingredients
design: one 26-entry supply count; per recipe a 26-entry need count compared against it

title: Reconstruct Billing Status (Variant 1)
complexity: O(t + u log u) time/O(u) space
design: one pass into a hash map of balances, then sort the user ids

title: Reconstruct Billing Status (Variant 2)
complexity: O(t + u log u) time/O(u) space
design: one pass that skips rows after the timestamp and accumulates into a hash map, then sort the user ids

title: Reconstruct Billing Status (Variant 3)
design: one global sort of all rows by (timestamp, transactionId), then a single replay keeping running balance and peak per user in hash maps

title: Reduce Gifts
design: sort ascending; the condition only depends on the k largest remaining, which are best removed from the top; slide a window of the k largest remaining prices down until its sum is at most threshold

title: Reduce The Maximum To Even K Times
complexity: O(n + k log n) time/O(n) space
design: a binary max-heap; k pops and pushes of the halved maximum, stopping early once the maximum is 0

title: Referral Credit Tracker (Variant 1)
design: array of running totals; referral adds to the referrer slot

title: Referral Credit Tracker (Variant 2)
complexity: O(log n) amortized per update; O(k log n) per top-k query
design: running totals plus a lazy max-heap of (total, id) entries; stale entries discarded on pop; popped valid entries pushed back

title: Regex Pattern Matching
design: parse the pattern into units (contents, starred); fill a boolean table dp[i][u] = text[i:] matches units u.. from the end, where a starred unit either is skipped or matches its contents at i and stays at the same unit

title: Related Communities Finder (Variant 1)
complexity: O(n + memberships reachable in two steps) time/O(n) space
design: walk the target community followers, and for each follower its community list, marking community indices in a boolean array; collect marked indices in increasing order

title: Related Communities Finder (Variant 2)
complexity: O(n + m + memberships) time/O(n + m) space
design: breadth-first search over the bipartite community/follower graph with visited arrays for both sides

title: Remove Covered Point
design: subtract interval lengths from idx until it falls inside an interval, then split that interval arithmetically

title: Remove Prefix String
complexity: O(n log n * L) time/O(n) space
design: sorted copy; a word is a strict prefix of some word iff its sorted successor starts with it

title: Repair Bootloader Program (Variant 1)
design: parse once into opcode and value arrays; walk with a visited byte array

title: Repair Bootloader Program (Variant 2)
design: reverse-edge search from index len marks every index that already terminates; along the original path, a switch at i works exactly when its new successor is marked (or is len); take the smallest such i and replay once

title: Request Routing System (Variant 1)
design: name->index map plus parallel arrays; linear scan with an incremental best (distance, load, name)

title: Request Routing System (Variant 2)
design: name->index map plus parallel arrays including a health flag; linear scan

title: Request Routing System (Variant 3)
design: name->index map plus parallel arrays (health, load); linear scan

title: Restore String with Target Digit Sum
design: greedy left to right: give each ? the smallest digit that still leaves a reachable remainder (0 <= rest <= remaining ? count * maxVal)

title: Reverse Count and Say
design: backtracking over 1- or 2-digit counts rejecting zero/leading-zero counts and equal adjacent digits

title: Reverse Middle of Vowel Words
design: string slicing: first character + reversed middle slice + last character for qualifying words

title: Reversi Move Simulation
complexity: O(n) time/O(n^2) space for the copy
design: eight-direction ray walk with collection of bracketed cells

title: Roadway Segment Speed Query
complexity: O(log C) per call, C = 1e6/O(C + u) space
design: two Fenwick trees over a difference array of positions 0 to 1e6 (speed sums and report counts), allocated on the first report, plus a hash map counting live copies of each (start, end, speed); a query is two prefix sums

title: Role Privilege System
complexity: O((n + edges) * P + n P log P) time for P distinct privileges/O(n P) space
design: Kahn topological order over parent -> child edges, computing each role once from its already-final parents with hash sets, then sorting

title: Route Nearest Checkpoint
complexity: O(N + Q (log N + N)) time/O(N + Q) space
design: prefix sums of segment lengths with binary search for the segment, then integer squared distances scaled by the segment length squared compared over all waypoints

title: Same Word of HTML Labels
complexity: O(N1 + N2) time/O(height) extra space beyond the input
design: two explicit stacks produce leaf texts lazily; compare character by character, advancing whichever leaf is exhausted, stopping at the first difference

title: Schedule Orders onto Planes
complexity: O(P log P + items log P) time/O(P) space
design: segment tree of remaining capacities over planes sorted by departure; a binary search finds the first eligible index and a descent finds the first plane with enough room; changes are logged and undone on rejection

title: Scooter Street Simulation
complexity: O(m log m) time/O(m) space, m = scooters
design: sort a copy of the positions below finish and sweep the union of [s, min(s + 10, finish)]

title: Search History System
complexity: O(1) per add, O(k) per getTopK/O(capacity) space
design: hash map from term to node of a doubly linked list with sentinels; add relinks at the head and unlinks the tail on overflow; getTopK walks k nodes from the head

title: Segment Sequence Reconstruction (Variant 1)
design: hash map from startId to segment and a set of endIds; the head is the only start that is not an end; follow the map and join payloads once

title: Segment Sequence Reconstruction (Variant 2)
design: hash map walk from the unique head with a step count; invalid when the number of heads is not one or the walk does not visit every segment

title: Segment Sequence Reconstruction (Variant 3)
complexity: O(total length + h log h) time/O(n) space
design: hash map from startId; collect heads (starts that are not ends), sort them, and walk each chain

title: Select Table and Set Color
design: lazy paint: a stamped table color, stamped row colors and stamped cell colors in hash maps; getColor returns the color with the latest stamp

title: Sentence Variations with Anagram
complexity: O(sum of output length + wordSet letters log) time/O(output) space
design: group wordSet by sorted-letter signature; for each word take its sorted option list, then expand the product position by position in order; because anagrams have equal length the product order is already sorted

title: Set Parity Bits
design: fold the seven low bits with XOR shifts (x ^= x >> 4; x ^= x >> 2; x ^= x >> 1) to get their parity, then shift that parity into bit 7

title: Shard Rebalancing
complexity: O(n log n + n * insertion cost) time/O(n) space
design: sorted arrays of kept starts and ends; coverage at x is (#starts <= x) - (#ends < x), which is non-increasing from the current start, so a binary search over candidate points finds the trimmed start

title: Shift Units Protection
design: greedy over maximal runs of 1s: a run of L units starting at s > 0 protects any L of the L + 1 cities s - 1 .. s + L - 1, so add their sum minus the minimum; a run at s = 0 protects all its cities

title: Shipping Route Cost Paths (Variant 1)
design: parse each route once, filter by source and target, sort by (cost, method)

title: Shipping Route Cost Paths (Variant 2)
complexity: O(R + paths log paths) time/O(R + paths) space
design: adjacency lists by source; for each route out of source, either it reaches target or extend with routes from its target that reach target

title: Shipping Route Cost Paths (Variant 3)
design: Dijkstra with a binary heap over parsed adjacency lists

title: Shopping Cart Checkout (Variant 1)
design: manual split and character-code digit checks

title: Shopping Cart Checkout (Variant 2)
complexity: O(total characters + s log s) time/O(s) space
design: manual parse, insertion-ordered map aggregation, sort by sku

title: Shopping Cart Checkout (Variant 3)
complexity: O(total characters + s log s) time/O(s) space
design: manual parse, map aggregation, sort by (-cost, sku), slice

title: Shortest Hiking Distance
design: binary search on the longest day D in [largest adjacent gap, total length]; a greedy walk that goes as far as possible each day decides whether k rests suffice

title: Shortest Path in Unweighted Graph
design: adjacency arrays (CSR) and a breadth-first search from source that stops when target is dequeued

title: Shortest Path with Gas Stations
complexity: O(m n (F + 1)) time worst case/O(m n) space
