design: breadth-first search by move count keeping the best fuel seen per cell; a state is expanded only when it arrives with strictly more fuel than any earlier state at that cell

title: Simplify Expression
design: one left-to-right pass with a stack of group signs; each variable takes the product of its own sign and the enclosing group sign

title: Simulate a Deterministic Finite Automaton
design: forward table walk

title: Smallest Lexicographical Palindrome
design: count letters; the left half takes count // 2 of each letter in alphabetical order, the odd letter (if any) goes in the middle, then the mirrored half

title: Snake Game
design: deque of encoded cells (row * cols + col) plus a hash set of occupied cells; pop the tail before the self-collision test unless the move grows the snake

title: Snapshot Set Iterator
complexity: O(1) per mutation, amortized O(snapshot length) per iterator
design: append-only entry log with add/remove versions; iterator = (version, end index, cursor) skipping entries not live at its version

title: Snapshot Social Graph (Variant 1)
design: per-edge history of (snapshot counter, state) with the last entry overwritten within one snapshot period; binary search per query

title: Snapshot Social Graph (Variant 2)
complexity: O(T log h + r log r) per getFollowees with T touched edges
design: per-edge histories plus per-user list of every followee ever touched; filter by history lookup then sort

title: Snapshot Social Graph (Variant 3)
complexity: O(sum of touched degrees of followees * log h + c log c) per recommend
design: followees via touched sets and histories; count second-hop followees in a hash map; sort candidates

title: Snowy Mountain Path with Melting
design: keep the accumulated snow per point, update it once per day, and recompute the ascent with one pass

title: Spam Caller Counter
complexity: O((C + R) log R + K log K) for K reported callers
design: hash map receiver -> sorted report seconds (own civil-date arithmetic); per call two binary searches count reports in [t - window, t + window]

title: Sparse Matrix Operation
complexity: O(1) get/set, O(rows cols) add, O(rows cols + nnz(A) * row nnz(B)) multiply/O(nnz) space
design: per-row hash maps of non-zero columns; add merges the other matrix's non-zeros into a copy of the touched rows; multiply converts the operand to per-row non-zero lists and accumulates only non-zero products

title: Spelling Bee Word Finder
design: a 26-bit mask of allowed letters; one pass per word builds its letter mask and checks it against the allowed mask and the required bit

title: Split Array with Equal Sum
design: one pass with the total and a running prefix sum

title: Split Drainage Tree
design: iterative post-order subtree sums, min |total - 2*sub|

title: Split Stay Booking
design: per listing, greedy longest covered prefix from start and longest covered suffix to end; pair test by comparing prefix end and suffix start

title: Split Text into Lines
complexity: O(len(text)) time/O(1) extra space beyond the word scan
design: greedy single pass: keep the current line length and start a new line exactly when the next word does not fit

title: Stock Trade Ranking System
complexity: O(1) per trade; O(m log m) for the first ranking after a trade and O(m) to copy it otherwise/O(m) space, m = stocks
design: dictionary of totals plus a cached sorted name list that is rebuilt only after a trade since the last ranking; every ranking returns a copy

title: Stock Trades Matching (Variant 1)
complexity: O((h + s) log(h + s)) time/O(h + s) space
design: count street trades in a hash map, consume a count for each identical house trade, then collect leftovers and sort

title: Stock Trades Matching (Variant 2)
complexity: O((h + s) log(h + s)) time/O(h + s) space
design: hash-map exact round, then group leftovers by the first three fields, sort each group and pair house and street trades positionally; the excess of the larger side remains

title: Stream to Matrix Row Transformer
complexity: O(r log r + rows * c) time/O(r + rows * c) space
design: map each code to its column, bucket records by timestamp in a hash map, sort the distinct timestamps and sweep them carrying the current value of every column

title: Streaming Stop Token (Variant 1)
design: scan chunks in order and search each one for "<END>"; the first chunk that contains it ends the output with its prefix

title: Streaming Stop Token (Variant 2)
design: join the chunks once, find the first "<END>" with a substring search, then walk chunk offsets until the chunk that contains that start position

title: String Matches in Matrix
complexity: O(m * n + |s|) time/O(m + n + |s|) extra space
design: extract every row, column and down-right diagonal as a string and count (overlapping) occurrences of s in each with the Knuth-Morris-Pratt automaton

title: String Reorganization
design: greedy with a feasibility test: at each position try letters in order, skipping the previous letter, and accept the first whose removal leaves a multiset that can still be arranged without the same letter first

title: String Replacement
design: KMP failure table for target; scan source, emit characters, and on a full match emit the replacement and reset the automaton state to 0

title: String Tokenization
complexity: O(n * L) time/O(total key length) space, L = longest key
design: trie of the keys; from each position walk the trie as far as the text allows and remember the deepest node that ends a key

title: Student Reading Textbook
design: binary search on x in [1, max(pages)] with the day count sum(ceil(p / x)) as a monotone predicate

title: Subarray-First Iterator
complexity: O(|b|) construction; amortized O(1) per call
design: hash set of b values; two cursors advanced lazily, skipping a-values found in the set

title: Subarray with Most Target Element
design: sliding window count: add the entering element and remove the leaving one; update the best start only on a strict improvement

title: Subscription Billing Statement
design: turn events into day-of-year intervals with a plan, split each interval at month boundaries and accumulate price * days per month; divide once per month with integer half-up rounding

title: Subset Sum Equals K (Variant 1)
complexity: O(n * min(k, S - k) / w) word operations
design: reachable-sum bitset (a big integer) limited to min(k, sum - k) bits, using the complement symmetry; shift-or per element with early exit

title: Subset Sum Equals K (Variant 2)
design: counting knapsack over sums 0..min(k, sum - k) (complement symmetry), iterating sums downward for each element, modulo 1000000007

title: Subset Sum Equals K (Variant 3)
complexity: O(D * k / w + output size * D) for D distinct values
design: group equal values; a suffix reachability table (one big-integer bitset per distinct value) guides a depth-first enumeration that only enters branches that can still reach k

title: Subset Sum Target
complexity: O(n * target / word size) time/O(target) bits
design: reachable-sum bitset as one big integer: shift by each value, OR, and mask to target + 1 bits

title: Substring Wrapper
complexity: O(|s| * L) for longest element length L
design: a trie of elements; for each start position walk the trie along the word and remember the deepest terminal node; stop at the first start that matches

title: Suffix Maximum Count
design: one right-to-left pass storing the suffix maximum and its count at every index, then look up each query

title: Sum of Islands Max
design: iterative depth-first search with an explicit stack and a visited matrix, summing each island as it is flooded and keeping the maximum

title: Tag Groups Complement Finder
complexity: O(total tags * log) time/O(total tags) space
design: build a hash set per group, test filter containment, add the other tags to a result hash set, then sort

title: Tail N Lines
design: sliding window: scan once, pushing each line start onto a fixed-size ring buffer of the last n starts; the answer starts at the oldest kept start

title: Target Stock Portfolio Operations
complexity: O(m * (initial + m)) time, O(initial + m) space
design: DP over (steps, holdings) with holdings capped by what can still return to target

title: Template String Formatter I (Variant 1)
design: one left-to-right scan collecting output pieces; on "{" read the name up to "}" and append its value from a hash map

title: Template String Formatter I (Variant 2)
design: memoised expansion per key in dependency order with an explicit stack (no recursion depth limit), then one scan of text

title: Template String Formatter II
design: single left-to-right parser: copy literals, and at "{" read the name, then either "}" or the fixed plural syntax, emitting the substituted text

title: Tetris Block Drop (Variant 1)
design: per block column, the lowest 1-cell and the highest occupied background cell in the matching grid column fix the landing row in one pass

title: Tetris Block Drop (Variant 2)
design: column-profile landing as in level 1, then one bottom-up compaction pass that keeps non-full rows

title: Text Box Formatter (Variant 1)
design: one pass for the maximum length, then three string concatenations per sentence with repeat/padding

title: Text Box Formatter (Variant 2)
design: greedy single pass per sentence building lines word by word, then one pass for the maximum line length and padded rendering

title: Text Box Formatter (Variant 3)
design: greedy wrap per sentence, then compute gap sizes arithmetically (base = spaces // gaps, the first spaces % gaps gaps get one more) and render

title: Thread Logs Processing (Variant 1)
design: parse every entry once and stable-sort the indices by (processId, threadId, timestamp)

title: Thread Logs Processing (Variant 2)
complexity: O(n + g log g) time/O(g) space, g = threads
design: one pass keeping count, minimum and maximum per (processId, threadId) in a hash map, then sort the keys

title: Three-Color Map Coloring
complexity: O(3^n) worst case, far less with the ordering
design: backtracking with DSATUR order (most constrained uncoloured node first), saturation counters and a fixed colour for the first node of each component

title: Threshold Alerts
design: running window sum, compared with alertThreshold * k in integers

title: Thrilling Teleporters (Variant 1)
complexity: O(t + d log d) time/O(t) space
design: parse the teleporters into a hash map, compute the end square of each roll, and deduplicate with a set before sorting

title: Thrilling Teleporters (Variant 2)
design: breadth-first search over squares from 0, where each square has up to dieSides successors given by the turn rule

title: Tic-Tac-Toe II
design: hash map of occupied cells; after a move count consecutive own marks outward from the new cell in each of the four directions (capped at k)

title: ToDo List with Task Dependencies (Variant 1)
complexity: O(1) expected per operation (O(d) copy for getDependencies)
design: hash map of task rows plus per-task ordered prerequisite list and edge set

title: ToDo List with Task Dependencies (Variant 2)
complexity: O(V+E) per addDependency; O((V+E) log V) per order
design: DFS reachability check per edge; Kahn with a binary min-heap

title: Top 10 Words (Variant 1)
design: count with a hash map, then keep a sorted buffer of at most 10 best entries by insertion while scanning the distinct words

title: Top 10 Words (Variant 2)
complexity: O(10) per word occurrence, O(10) per getTop10/O(U) space
design: hash-map counts plus a cached top-10 list; because counts only grow, an incremented word can only move up, so each increment updates the cached list in O(10)

title: Top K Book Sales
complexity: O(log B + B memmove) per sale, O(k) per getTopK/O(B) space
design: hash map of totals plus one array of all books sorted by (-total, id); a sale removes the book at its binary-searched position and reinserts it at the new one; getTopK slices

title: Top K Largest Elements
complexity: O(n log k + k log k) time/O(k) space
design: binary min-heap of size k over the stream of values (replace the root when a larger value arrives), then sort the heap contents decreasingly

title: Top K Pins
complexity: O(log P + P memmove) per addPin, O(k) per getTopK/O(P) space
design: hash map from type to an array kept sorted by (-score, id) with binary-search insertion; getTopK slices the first k ids

title: Top Love Message Receivers
design: hash set of pairs, hash counts, heap selection of k by (-count, name)

title: Toy Language Grammar  (Variant 1)
complexity: O(total node count + output length) time/O(depth) stack
design: one recursive formatter shared by parameters and return type, joining child strings

title: Toy Language Grammar  (Variant 2)
complexity: O(total node count + output length) time/O(number of generics + depth) space
design: simultaneous recursive walk of parameter and argument nodes, storing each generic binding by its formatted string in a hash map and failing on the first conflict

title: Transaction Incident Monitor (Variant 1)
design: sort by time, per-merchant deque sliding window with per-code counts; check codes seen at t

title: Transaction Incident Monitor (Variant 2)
complexity: O(n log n + evaluations * codes in window)
design: per-merchant deque window with per-code sums and a total; check every code in the window

title: Transaction Incident Monitor (Variant 3)
design: per-merchant deque window with per-code sums, total and an active set; evaluate codes in window plus active codes

title: Travese and Merge Two N-ary Trees (Variant 1)
design: explicit stack pushing children in reverse

title: Travese and Merge Two N-ary Trees (Variant 2)
design: explicit-stack pairwise merge emitting rows in pre-order

title: Triangle Point Membership
design: signs of the three edge cross products: inside or on the boundary when none is strictly negative and none strictly positive at the same time

title: Typed Task Lock
complexity: O(1) amortised per call plus the admitted ids/O(w) space, w = waiting jobs
design: running count, running type and a FIFO queue (deque in Python, array with a head index in JavaScript); a release that empties the lock admits the same-type queue prefix

title: Unequal Elements
complexity: O(n * k) time/O(d * k) space, d = distinct values
design: dynamic programme keyed by value: best[v][j] is the longest subsequence ending in value v with j changes, and top[j] the best over all values; each element extends best[v][j] by one or starts a new run after top[j - 1], updating j from k down to 0

title: Uniform Group Spanning Tree
complexity: O(K * L) big-integer work for an L-digit rank plus O(K log K) decoding
design: big-integer mixed-radix digit extraction, then heap-based Pruefer decoding

title: URL Maze Traversal (Variant 1)
design: queue BFS with a seen set

title: URL Maze Traversal (Variant 2)
design: queue BFS carrying the discovering response's header map

title: URL Query Parameter Parsing
design: manual split on "&" and the first "=" with a hash map that promotes a value to a list on the second occurrence

title: URL Router Design
complexity: O(min(T, 2^L)) per call worst case, T = trie nodes, L = path segments; O(L) per addRoute/O(total pattern segments) space
design: segment trie whose children are literal segments plus one "*" child; a query walks the trie depth first, literal child before "*", carrying the wildcard count, pruning branches whose count already exceeds the best complete match, and keeps the first best match found in that order

title: User Flight Location Tracker
design: filter the user's flights, sort by departure time, and binary search the last departure at or before the query time

title: User Journey Paths
design: trie of maps with per-node user counts, stack pre-order with sorted children; timestamps compared by length then digits

title: Valid Time Combinations
design: permutations of the four digits deduplicated in a set, checking hour < 24 and minute < 60

title: Valid Zero-Based Permutation Check
complexity: O(n) time/O(n) space for the copy (O(1) beyond it)
design: cyclic placement on a private copy: swap each in-range value into its own index; a value outside 0..n-1 or a second copy of a value already in place means false

title: Validate  Playlist Sequence
design: for each pair of consecutive equal plays at positions j < i with i - j < numSongs, the cut must fall in j+1..i, an arc of residues mod numSongs; add each arc to a difference array and accept when some residue is covered by every arc

title: Variadic Function Matching
design: hash maps keyed by joined type lists; query probes exact key and each prefix within the trailing equal-type run

title: Violation Log Analyzer
complexity: O(n) build, O(log n + k) per query for k logs in range/O(n) space
design: group logs by post and by policy keeping date order; binary-search the date range in the group (or the whole log) and count distinct keys in that slice with a hash set

title: Vowels Substring
design: one pass: for each end position keep the start of the current vowel run and the last position of each vowel; add (smallest last position - run start + 1) when all five have appeared in the run

title: Warehouse Package Allocation
design: simulate with a circular doubly linked list of open centers, so passing the turn and closing a center are O(1)

title: Weighted Cache
complexity: O(log n) amortised per put, O(1) get/O(n) space
design: hash map key -> (value, weight, write stamp) plus a max-heap of (weight, -stamp, key) with lazy deletion of stale entries

title: Wildcard Matching
complexity: O(|s| * |p|) worst case with a linear substring search, usually near linear/O(|p|) space
design: split p at "*" into literal pieces; the first piece must be a prefix of s and the last a suffix (when p has a "*"), and each middle piece is placed at its leftmost occurrence after the previous one, which is optimal because "*" absorbs any gap

title: Wildcard Search
design: split the pattern on "*"; the answer is the first occurrence of the first piece (found with KMP), provided the remaining pieces can then be found in order with KMP from where each previous piece ended

title: Windowed Average excluding Largest K
design: two lazy-deletion heaps: a min-heap holding the k largest (value, index) entries of the window and a max-heap with the rest; a location array marks which heap owns each live index and running sums give each average in O(1)

title: Windowed Key-Value Store
design: insertion-ordered hash map (OrderedDict / Map) delete-and-reinsert for recency; evict first key

title: Winner in a Dot Grid Game
design: keep a set of placed sticks and, per move, test only the one or two squares that the new stick borders

title: Word Pattern Match
complexity: O(total characters) time/O(alphabet) space per word
design: per word, one pass with two maps (pattern character to word character and back), failing at the first conflict

title: Word Search in a Straight Line
complexity: O(m n 8 L) time worst case/O(1) space
design: for every cell matching the first letter and every direction, step along and compare letters until a mismatch or the board edge

title: Work Schedule
design: backtracking in position order with digit order 0..dayHours and remaining-capacity pruning (output is generated already sorted)

title: Worker-Task Matching with Specialties (Variant 1)
complexity: O((w + t) log w) time/O(w + t) space
design: min-heap of (workload, name, index); pop the top, assign, push back with the new workload

title: Worker-Task Matching with Specialties (Variant 2)
complexity: O((w s + t s) log(w s + t s)) time for s specialties per worker/O(w s + t s) space
design: one lazy min-heap per task type holding (workload, name, index, version); on assignment bump the worker version and push fresh entries into the heaps of all its specialties

title: Worker-Task Matching with Specialties (Variant 3)
complexity: O((w s + t s) log(w s + t s)) time/O(w s + t s) space
design: lazy per-type min-heaps as in level 2; a worker at its limit simply gets no fresh entries, so its old entries are discarded as stale

title: Write Disk Block With Cycle
complexity: O(n) to build plus O(log n) per write/O(n) space
design: min-heap of (remaining writes, id) over writable blocks; a write decrements the top and pops it when it reaches zero
